niche: posting a national screening agency's one mobile screening unit to one of eight flagged airports for the summer, judged by the passengers it moves within the 20-minute queue standard, when host airports stand down their own lanes while the unit is there
answer: Post the mobile screening unit to Halloran Bay from 15 June to 31 August 2027: it moves 382,700 passengers within the 20-minute standard, against 237,700 at Cullinvale, and 14 per cent is the smallest whole per cent shortfall in Halloran Bay's forecast passengers at which another posting would move more.
stakeholder_role: head of screening operations at a national aviation security agency, who posts the agency's one mobile screening team for the summer peak

spine.entity: one screening lane in one 15-minute interval at one central checkpoint, summer 2026, with people through its divest point (passenger lanes, the mobile unit's positions, two staff and aircrew lanes)
spine.source: synthetic (fictional national screening agency's lane sensors)

world.geography: fictional country (Kestland), North Atlantic island republic, English-speaking
world.org_type: national aviation security agency that screens passengers at ten airports and keeps one mobile screening unit

driver: When a shared resource is posted to a unit, the unit's own managers stand down part of their own resource for the time it is there, so the shared resource's own output overstates what the unit gains; the gain is the net change in the unit's total resource at the busy intervals, read from past postings interval by interval against the unit's plan; most units stand down a fixed part all day and one stands down only in its quiet intervals, so neither the gross addition nor a day-averaged stand-down ranks the units right.
driver_concrete: On every posted day last summer seven of the eight host airports' duty managers stood down two of their own lanes for the whole of the mobile unit's day (and more after the banks), and Halloran Bay stood down none through its banks; run on the 2027 design days, the planning standard's passengers moved within 20 minutes follow the lanes open by interval, so the unit adds one lane at the banks everywhere but Halloran Bay, where it adds three and moves the most (382,700 against Cullinvale's 237,700); averaging Halloran Bay's after-bank stand-down over the day names Eskerford.
stump: A competent solver runs the planning standard on each airport's 2027 design days and summer roster pattern with the unit's three lanes added and posts the unit to Cullinvale (730,800 passengers moved within the standard); the step that lands it there is taking the roster pattern plus three as the lanes that will be open, when every posted day last summer shows seven hosts standing down two of their own lanes for the whole of the unit's day and Halloran Bay none through its banks, so the unit moves the most at Halloran Bay (382,700).
analyst_test: A strong analyst who reads the planning standard, the summer 2027 design days and roster patterns and the postings file correctly adds the unit's three lanes to each airport's roster pattern, runs the standard and posts the unit to Cullinvale; wrong, because the hosts' own lanes open while the unit screened fell short of their pattern last summer, two lanes all day at seven airports and none through Halloran Bay's banks.
domain_test: The deciding analysis is checkpoint capacity planning: a fluid queue on 15-minute arrivals against the lanes actually open, scored against the 20-minute wait standard, with the lanes a posting adds read net of the host's own response from the lane sensors and roster patterns of past postings; with another field's nouns there is no lane, queue standard, wait threshold or host roster, and the task stops making sense.
notes: Seed AD07's own mechanism (the team opens lanes only where a lane position stands idle, a per-airport cap that re-places the pick) is the dead F3 shape (58 v3 and v4) and its pick-one shape 01 is banned against task181 and task183; the decision and quantity are kept, the pitfall is re-found as interference: the host's response to the posting. Shape 13 (each airport's posting a scenario, the flip the host release at peak that would move the call) because 07 and 01 are banned against task180 and task181.
